<!-- Use this when existing behaviour is not a defect but is not good enough, or when
the answer depends on an unmade decision. A violation of an adopted standard is
a bug report; deciding which standard to adopt belongs here.
Redact secrets and personal data from evidence. -->

## Problem

What is inadequate today, measured where possible. Observation only; save
"should" for the Proposal section.

## Evidence

Numbers, counts, or examples and where they were taken (entry point, environment,
commit or date). Include cases that pass as well as those that fail.

### Verification snippet

A command, test, script, or DevTools snippet a reviewer can run to see the same
evidence. Include prerequisites and expected output, or explain why it does not apply.

## Who this affects

Name the users and workflow. Explain how their goals change the impact.

## Options

Give real alternatives with costs, including doing nothing. For a decision issue,
this is the most important section; the Proposal section may stay empty.

**A.**

- Cost:
- Risk:

**B.**

- Cost:
- Risk:

**C. Do nothing**: what it costs to leave this as it is.

## Proposal

The recommended option and why. Omit if this issue exists to get a decision.

## Acceptance criteria

Write criteria a reviewer can prove, in the same units as the Evidence section.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Out of scope

Explicit exclusions, with links to the issues covering them instead.
